properties.value: Exactly one model per prompt, chosen as the argmax of a learned per-prompt quality score (or a quality-minus-cost score) over a fixed model pool.
properties.tradeoff: Every prompt gets exactly one attempt at one model; there is no escalation, no second opinion and no notion of the request having named a model in the first place.

properties.value: Two shipped shapes: a soft price preference folded into the objective as a weighted sum of normalised accuracy and normalised cost, and a hard per-prompt dollar budget that makes an over-budget choice infeasible.
properties.tradeoff: The soft form guarantees only a trade-off direction, with shipped weight pairs (1.0,0.0), (0.5,0.5) and (0.2,0.8) and an AvengersPro default of 0.7 performance / 0.3 cost; the hard form guarantees no prompt exceeds its budget, default $0.1.

properties.value: Stateless at inference time and fully seeded, so a replay is exactly reproducible.
properties.tradeoff: The same fitted policy on the same split produces byte-identical decisions; no cross-request state is carried.

properties.value: not decided: the benchmark models a single-attempt offline lookup over a frozen (prompt x model) table, with no fleet, no clock and no failures.
